lastCompletedStory.title: Rebrand in-app product display strings to CAM Runtime

nextStoryContext: index.ts: HELP.tagline now reads 'CAM Runtime: a local software-delivery runtime for coding agents' (was 'Autonomous Claude Code loop driver'), and the 'version' command's HelpEntry.description now reads 'Print the installed CAM Runtime version (also `--version` / `-v`)'. src/commands/run.ts: tmux status-right (line ~518) now reads ' CAM Runtime ' (was ' cam-cli '), still under status-right-length 24; the neighboring comment ('Right: CAM Runtime.') was updated to match but the older comment at line ~478 ('active pane | dim nav hint | cam-cli') was left untouched since it's not one of the 4 display strings the story named and is not behavior-affecting. src/retry/config.ts: DEFAULT_TOML header comment now reads '# CAM Runtime retry configuration'; the github.com/eduardocaminha/cam-cli url on the next line was deliberately left unchanged (repo rename is out of scope). No behavior-affecting name (cam command, ~/.cam, ~/.config/cam, CAM_* env vars, tmux socket 'cam'/@cam_label/cam-orch session prefix, .cam-* markers, chore(cam): trailers) was touched -- verified by grep that none of those tokens appear in the diff. No test asserted the old strings, so no test changes were needed.
